Sensation in the left nasal fossa as if a hard

blown out of the nose, early in the morning. Bleeding at

sections.text:
Aching of the facial bones, increased by walk-

sometimes very violent in the right ; in the left it is some-

it, in the evening. Small, red, itching vesicles, full of
water, on the chin, (6. d.) Frequent tearing in the left
lower jaw, (4. d.) Rheumatic pain in the jaws. Throb-
bing in the right lower jaw, from the middle till the front
of The knee, after breakfast, (1. d.) Pain, as if bruised,

bing, in the left articulation of the jaw, going off by press-

ing of the sub-maxillary glands. Toothache, with swell-

We have almost no knowledge of the curative powers
